rounds.title: PBE5AC_CABLEVEL_15_AND_NOTSENT_LOWAT_16384_ON_V7
rounds.hypothesis: Clamping wifi0 CABlevel to its minimum 15% beacon-interval bound (ATHDEV-BUG-02 ath_cabq_update 0x016908) and setting net.ipv4.tcp_notsent_lowat=16384 on top of Stage 79A Champion v7 (set_multiq=3, Burst:5000) reduces unsent socket buffer bloat and CAB beacon hold latency.

rounds.title: PBE5AC_BURST_4500_FINE_GRID_ON_V7
